rationale: No Henry Hub (yfinance/FRED) series exists in the catalogue, so the closest available proxy for the upstream fuel-price shock is the monthly oil delivered fuel cost, tested against gas delivered fuel cost (both freq=M, coverage to 2026-05) as monthly pct_change with up to a 30-day (one-month) lead and a pre/post-war comparison to check whether the lag shortened; caveats: n is very small (~15 months, ~3 war months), both series share the war-driven energy-price trend as a common cause, and the proxy is not Henry Hub.
